/*
NEW DECSUB CLASS
DESCRIPTION: TO CHECK IF DCLTN_NBR IS TRUE OR NOT
PROGRAMMER : OMAR MANSOUR
VERSION : 1.
DATE : 9-4-1426
*/

/*
NEW DECSUB CLASS
DESCRIPTION: TO CHECK IF DCLTN_NBR IS CHOISE FROM LIST OR NOT
PROGRAMMER : ANAS AL-HABASHI
VERSION : 1.
DATE : 29-4-1426
*/
IF :GLOBAL.DCL_VALID= 0 THEN
DECLARE
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 
IF :DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT COUNT (DCLTN_ISN)
 INTO V_COUNT 
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :P_DCLTN_TYPE;
 
 IF V_COUNT = 1 THEN
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN, DCLTN_DT
 INTO :P_DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_DT
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :P_DCLTN_TYPE;
 ELSIF V_COUNT > 1 THEN
 check_list_val;
 :GLOBAL.DCL_VALID:=0;

 ELSIF V_COUNT < 1 THEN
 MESSAGE('رقم البيان غير صحيح فضلا تأكد من الرقم الصحيح');
 MESSAGE('رقم البيان غير صحيح فضلا تأكد من الرقم الصحيح');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 MESSAGE('رقم البيان غير صحيح فضلا تأكد من الرقم الصحيح');
 MESSAGE('رقم البيان غير صحيح فضلا تأكد من الرقم الصحيح');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

END ;
END IF;

-------------------------------------
DECLARE
 V_DCLN_STA NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_CD
 INTO V_DCLN_STA
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN = :P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :P_DCLTN_TYPE;

IF V_DCLN_STA <> 9 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب أن يكون البيان مفسوحاً','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(7);
 DECL_T VARCHAR2(600);
 CHK VARCHAR2(500);
 CNT VARCHAR2(600);
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
---------------------------------------------------------------------
IF :P_DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN -- OR :P_DGT_SEQ IS NULL THEN
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,280,'ERROR');
ELSE 
 SELECT
 COUNT(DGT.PORT_CD) INTO v_count
 FROM
----------
DECLARATIONS DCLTN,
DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WHERE
 DGT.PORT_CD =:PORT AND
:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (1,2)
AND
DGT.DCLTN_ISN=:P_DCLTN_ISN 
AND
DGT_TYPE IN (5,6) 
AND
DCLTN.PORT_CD =DGT.PORT_CD AND
DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN =DGT.DCLTN_ISN AND
DCLTN_STA_CD = 9 
;
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 if v_count > 0 then 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 
 --:FINANCE_DT := revenue.get_fiscal_year_start(:start_dt);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PORT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,0);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_ISN',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DCLTN_ISN);
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DGT_SEQ',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DGT_SEQ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 
 else
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if; 


END IF;
END ;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_LIST_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_list_val IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_BASIC_BATCHES';
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة الاختيار ');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .10);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PORT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DCLTN_TYPE_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DCLTN_TYPE);
 IF :DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DCLTN_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_NBR);
 END IF;
 
 CALL_FORM('LOV_BRKR_DCLTNS.fmx',NO_HIDE,NO_REPLACE,QUERY_ONLY,pl_id);
 
 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_NBR := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR ;
 :DCLTN_DT := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_DT;
 :P_DCLTN_ISN := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN;
 :GLOBAL.DCL_VALID:=1;
 END IF;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END;
